events.text:
workspace_identity:
  name: "Forensic Maestro/Mosaic reconstruction workspace"
  type: forensic
  date_window: "2026-03-30 to 2026-05-20; active project threads visible from 2026-04-15 to 2026-05-20"
  approximate_session_count: "about 21 visible project threads plus imported artifact/session surfaces"
  custom_gpt_or_project: "ChatGPT Project: Forensic; loaded canon is dev-session replay auditor discipline with Maestro/Mosaic reconstruction constraints and v5-c/v3-aligned operating posture"

unique_contribution:
  description: >
    This workspace contributes the strongest replay-governed authority discipline,
    not merely another Maestro runtime proposal. Its distinctive value is the
    separation of evidence classes: files1-3 as ancestor baseline, files4 as
    split/bridge, files5 as runtime/product candidate emergence, and files6 as
    current forensic/V&V control. It also preserves the non-promotional status
    of Mosaic Engine and Maestro v0 while identifying exact decision blockers
    for Day 2 rather than allowing polished artifacts or Claude summaries to
    promote themselves.
  artifacts:

- "WIRING_RECOVERY_V_AND_V_v0.md — controls files4→files5→files6 V&V chain; orientation/V&V only; no canon promotion."
    - "SOURCE_GAP_LIST_v0 / v0.1 — freezes unresolved source gaps and prevents unauthorized reconstruction of missing governance or metric content."
    - "maestro_transfer_package.md — air-gap continuation package preserving reconstruction-first authority hierarchy, stable truths, unresolved items, and Promotion Matrix next step."

- "Forensic Reconstruction Blocked.txt — blocker reassessment showing feasibility is less blocked than governance, boundary, and canon-promotion decisions."
    - "04_AMAZON_6PAGE_REPORT.md — handoff report stabilizing Technical UST as canonical addressable superspace, Creative UST as downstream, and SEM as concurrent quality substrate; derivative evidence only."

- "Maestro Evolution Comparison.txt — corrected origin comparison preserving middle/pressure/Technical UST/null-as-address lessons as development evidence rather than clean endpoint narrative."

current_open_state:
  last_active_work_item: "Day 2 alignment prep: produce a workspace-local self-report for synthesizing Claude without collapsing this forensic workspace into the other six workspaces."
  active_sidechains:

- sidechain_id: "SC-FOR-001"
      source_origin: "files4→files5→files6 wiring recovery chain"
      target_address_or_phase: "WORKSPACE_AUTHORITY_MAP_v0.1 / Day 2 evidence-contract surface"
      authority_boundary: "orientation/V&V only; Mosaic Engine v0.1 and Maestro v0 remain candidate runtime/product frames, not promoted canon"
      gate_effect: "permits authority-map orientation work; blocks Persona Schema, Substrate Spec, Blueprint v0.1, Q1-Q16 reconstruction, SongCouncil metric reconstruction, and VIS/K8 inference until operator decisions"
      completion_status: "active_partial"

- sidechain_id: "SC-FOR-002"
      source_origin: "current cross-workspace Day 2 prompt"
      target_address_or_phase: "synthesizing Claude Day 2 alignment packet"
      authority_boundary: "validation + documentation handoff only; no canon promotion from this YAML"
      gate_effect: "surfaces conflicts, readiness, and missing edges for peer review"
      completion_status: "complete_for_this_turn_provisional"

- sidechain_id: "SC-FOR-003"
      source_origin: "Clarity/Eldrik/Claude reformulation artifacts"
      target_address_or_phase: "interpretive calibration and language repair"
      authority_boundary: "sidechain evidence; may inform phrasing but cannot override replay-governed Maestro/Mosaic canon"
      gate_effect: "helps detect Q&A drift, artifact-first misread, and pressure/dialogue flattening"
      completion_status: "open_reference_only"
  active_slipstreams:

- slipstream_id: "SS-FOR-001"
      name: "Authority Map v0.1"
      lifecycle_state: "recommended_not_yet_promoted"
      origin_delta: "transfer package requires Promotion Matrix; blocker reassessment says Authority Map v0.1 is safest next artifact"
      reason_for_existence: "gives Day 2 one stable navigation surface across baseline, split, candidate, current-control, out-of-chain, and frozen-gap artifacts"

- slipstream_id: "SS-FOR-002"
      name: "Persona Schema Decision Packet"
      lifecycle_state: "scoped_paused"
      origin_delta: "updated blocker map says Persona Schema is blocked by GAP-02 SongCouncil metrics path and GAP-06 executive committee composition"
      reason_for_existence: "turns a broad blocked schema problem into two bounded operator decisions without prematurely drafting the schema"

- slipstream_id: "SS-FOR-003"
      name: "Substrate Boundary Decision Docket"
      lifecycle_state: "scoped_paused"
      origin_delta: "updated blocker map says Substrate Spec is blocked by NS-4, GAP-08, GAP-09, and GAP-11"
      reason_for_existence: "separates Mosaic substrate/application boundary decisions from Persona Schema and from general recap work"

- slipstream_id: "SS-FOR-004"
      name: "Regression Evidence Capture"
      lifecycle_state: "external_reported_not_loaded_here"
      origin_delta: "current prompt reports a Triad-validator slice shipped in another Claude session"
      reason_for_existence: "potential validator-tactical evidence; this forensic workspace should not treat it as loaded until artifacts/results are imported"
  open_q_a_without_f:

- q: "Can the three backbone files be used directly when file contents failed to load?"
      a: "Assistant said the files were unreadable and proposed a generic skeleton for technical.ust, song-excellence, and creative.ust."
      missing_f: true
      pending_since: "eldrik / 2026-03-28 imported session marker"

- q: "What is the exact relationship among SE20, BICDM-20, and SEM-12?"
      a: "Current blocker reassessment says SE20 has stronger operational shape but the relationship remains unresolved."
      missing_f: true
      pending_since: "post-corpus-update blocker reassessment"
    - q: "Which workforce model is promoted: 5-Council default, 13-worker expansion, or 13 core workers plus 4 Plane-4 surface governors?"
      a: "Forensic materials warn against '17 SMEs' language and keep workforce default unresolved."
      missing_f: true
      pending_since: "files6 / V&V control pass"
  unresolved_contradictions:

- "Mosaic Engine v0.1 is formal candidate runtime, but not promoted substrate canon."
    - "Maestro v0 is formal candidate product/application frame, but not promoted project canon."
    - "Technical UST is treated as canonical truth substrate in v5-c support material, while forensic discipline still requires replay-backed promotion paths."

- "Creative UST is called output canon, but only as downstream Suno-facing shell; it must not be treated as peer authority with Technical UST."
    - "SEM is both historical score/rubric material and current concurrent admissibility substrate; its relation to SE20/BICDM-20 remains unresolved."
    - "files4→files5→files6 chain is controlling for wiring recovery, but not sufficient to close council/matrix content gaps."

- "Claude reformulations are highly useful but cannot be adopted wholesale under this workspace's hard guards."
    - "VIG/SEL and visual materials are available as reference layers, but out-of-chain and not substrate canon."

cross_workspace_conflicts_or_supersessions:
  - this_workspace_holds: "files4→files5→files6 is a V&V chain: files4 names the substrate, files5 specifies candidate runtime/product, files6 verifies/corrects wiring without promoting runtime/product candidates."
    likely_conflicts_with: "any workspace treating Mosaic Engine v0.1 or Maestro v0 as already-canon runtime/product specifications"
    proposed_resolution: "needs Promotion Matrix and operator adjudication before downstream canon use"

- this_workspace_holds: "Documents and artifacts are evidence classes; assistant outputs and Claude summaries are proposals unless accepted, replay-backed, or made operative."
    likely_conflicts_with: "Claude-session syntheses or polished handoff packets that appear complete"
    proposed_resolution: "use as derivative evidence only; verify by dev-session replay and artifact authority map"

- this_workspace_holds: "Diagrams and images are diagnostic human-view references only, not canon."
    likely_conflicts_with: "visual-recovery workspaces that may treat diagram polish or labels as authoritative"
    proposed_resolution: "label diagrams as explanatory/handoff artifacts with state tags"

- this_workspace_holds: "Do not use '17 SMEs'; use '13 core Maestro workers + 4 Plane-4 surface governors' unless operator revises."
    likely_conflicts_with: "workspaces using flattened 17-SME language"
    proposed_resolution: "standardize terminology in Day 2 authority map; keep workforce default unresolved"

- this_workspace_holds: "Authority Map v0.1 and decision packets are safer next slices than Substrate Spec or Persona Schema drafting."
    likely_conflicts_with: "implementation-heavy workspaces ready to draft schemas/specs immediately"
    proposed_resolution: "run evidence-contract slice first; then open validator-tactical or classifier-routing only after blocker boundaries are explicit"

- claim: "Mosaic is framed as separable substrate/runtime while Maestro is the music application/product frame; this substrate/application distinction is central and still promotion-bounded."
      source_within_workspace: "WIRING_RECOVERY_V_AND_V_v0 and files4/files5/files6 branch model."
      pre_filing_sensitive: false
      redaction: null

- claim: "SEM is not merely post-hoc scoring; it is concurrent admissibility and quality substrate used while UST addresses are resolved."
      source_within_workspace: "Canonical SEM and Amazon handoff lineage."
      pre_filing_sensitive: true
      redaction: "Detailed scoring-to-worker-routing mechanics should remain controlled until filing posture is decided."

Exact worker contracts, default workforce composition, executive committee composition, and SongCouncil metrics remain unresolved."
  classifier_routing_rules_drafted: partial
  classifier_routing_evidence: "This workspace has strong source-role and authority-routing rules: reconstruction-first, no source-class flattening, no silent canon promotion, authority hierarchy, and Promotion Matrix requirements. It does not yet expose the four PENDING_CLASSIFIER stubs reported in the external Claude session as loaded local artifacts."
  vig_sel_post_generation_pipeline_status: scoped
  vig_sel_evidence: "vig.zip is present and classified in V&V materials as out-of-chain reference layer rather than substrate wiring canon; no local promotion path for VIG/SEL post-generation pipeline is established in this packet."

scope_classification_per_three_planes:
  PROJECT_MAESTRO:
    - "Technical UST as canonical/null-rich/addressable creative superspace, subject to replay-backed promotion discipline."
    - "Creative UST as definitive downstream Suno lyrics-prompt shell, not deep worksheet or peer authority to Technical UST."

- "SEM as concurrent quality/admissibility substrate rather than final-only scorecard."
    - "Maestro.Project, Maestro.App, and Maestro.Runtime distinctions must remain visible."
    - "Maestro and Mosaic are distinct: Maestro is music/app/product lineage; Mosaic is substrate/runtime candidate."
  WORKSPACE_DEV:

- "Dev-session replay governs canon formation."
    - "User turns are deltas/corrections/constraints/decisions; assistant turns are proposals unless accepted."
    - "Mutation ledger / Promotion Matrix / authority map discipline."
    - "No artifact-first misread, no false completion, no diagram-as-canon, no polished-handoff overauthority."

- "Current workspace should produce evidence contracts and blocker packets before schema/spec drafting."
  BRIDGE_PROJECT_WORKSPACE:
    - "WIRING_RECOVERY_V_AND_V_v0 bridges project-level Maestro/Mosaic claims to workspace-level source strata and verification state."
    - "maestro_transfer_package.md bridges continuation protocol, authority hierarchy, stable truths, unresolved items, and Promotion Matrix next step."

- "Forensic Reconstruction Blocked.txt bridges recovered corpus state to actionable Day 2 blocker queues."
    - "This YAML packet bridges this workspace to synthesizing Claude as validation/documentation input, not as canon."

    - "v5-b vs v5-c vs forensic precedence."
    - "Mosaic role: candidate runtime substrate versus promoted project canon."

- "Third surface naming and exact output-surface taxonomy."
    - "SE20 vs BICDM-20 vs SEM-12 relationship."
    - "G-Card scalar reconciliation: 7/10 versus 97.5/100."
    - "VIS/K8 scope and +4 surface-governor placement."
    - "Exact executive committee composition."
    - "Q1-Q16 content and SongCouncil per-member metrics."

- "Whether external Triad-validator slice should be imported as regression evidence, validator-tactical basis, or separate Claude-only state."

handoff_to_synthesizing_claude:
  most_important_thing_to_carry_forward: >
    This workspace's strongest atom is not another Maestro definition; it is the
    authority discipline that prevents wrong definitions from becoming canon.
    Carry forward the files1-3 → files4 → files5 → files6 source-strata model,
    the non-promotional status of Mosaic/Maestro candidate specs, and the need
    for Promotion Matrix / Authority Map v0.1 before schema or substrate drafting.
  warning_about_misreading_this_workspace: >
    Do not mistake this workspace for the Maestro runtime itself. It is a
    forensic reconstruction and evidence-governance workspace. Its job is to
    decide what can be trusted, promoted, blocked, or routed, not to collapse
    Maestro, Mosaic, substrate, wiring recovery, project workspaces, documents,
    Claude summaries, and diagrams into one clean architecture.
  recommended_next_slice_from_this_workspace_perspective: >
    evidence-contract. The workspace most supports Authority Map v0.1 plus two
    bounded decision packets: Persona Schema decisions and Substrate Boundary
    decisions. Validator-tactical work can follow, but only after the evidence
    contract prevents classifier/routing logic from inheriting unresolved canon
    conflicts.

authority_map_seed:
  controlling_principle: >
    The forensic workspace should contribute an evidence contract before it
    contributes architecture synthesis. Its most valuable function is to prevent
    cross-workspace synthesis from mistaking completeness, polish, recency, or
    coherence for canon.
  source_classes:

- class_id: "SC0"
      name: "operator_current_delta"
      authority_role: "highest active instruction for this turn"
      promotion_effect: "can constrain output immediately; does not alone rewrite historical canon unless explicitly framed as correction"
    - class_id: "SC1"
      name: "dev_session_replay"
      authority_role: "primary canon-forming evidence"
      promotion_effect: "can promote mutations only when appearance, clarification, pressure survival, operative carry-forward, and non-supersession are shown"

- class_id: "SC2"
      name: "operator_confirmed_artifact"
      authority_role: "strong evidence when linked to replay or explicit acceptance"
      promotion_effect: "can confirm replay-derived canon; cannot override replay by polish"
    - class_id: "SC3"
      name: "forensic_control_artifact"
      authority_role: "governs recovery posture, gaps, branch models, blockers"
      promotion_effect: "routes or blocks downstream work; usually not runtime canon itself"

- class_id: "SC4"
      name: "candidate_runtime_or_product_spec"
      authority_role: "formal candidate, not promoted canon"
      promotion_effect: "may be used as candidate target only with state labels"
    - class_id: "SC5"
      name: "handoff_or_summary"
      authority_role: "derivative compression"
      promotion_effect: "helps orient; cannot promote claims independently"

- class_id: "SC6"
      name: "diagram_or_image"
      authority_role: "human-view diagnostic or explanatory reference"
      promotion_effect: "can reveal intended distinctions; cannot establish canon by visual polish"

promotion_matrix_seed:
  required_columns:
    - "claim_or_artifact"
    - "scope_plane"

- "source_class"
    - "authority_tier"
    - "current_status"
    - "promotion_requirement"
    - "blocking_reason"
    - "downstream_risk_if_promoted_early"
    - "recommended_next_action"
  seed_rows:
    - claim_or_artifact: "Technical UST is canonical null-rich addressable creative superspace"
      scope_plane: "PROJECT_MAESTRO"
      source_class: "SC2 plus replay corroboration required for formal canon package"
      authority_tier: "high_but_requires_replay_path_for_each_downstream_claim"
      current_status: "operative_project_claim_with_forensic_caution"
      promotion_requirement: "show replay path from Technical UST as codec/null-address substrate through v5-c support artifacts"
      blocking_reason: "risk of treating support artifact statement as sufficient without replay"
      downstream_risk_if_promoted_early: "schema and worker contracts may inherit unvalidated assumptions"
      recommended_next_action: "bind exact Technical UST axis/key/subkey semantics to worker completion contract"

- claim_or_artifact: "Creative UST is downstream output canon"
      scope_plane: "PROJECT_MAESTRO"
      source_class: "SC2"
      authority_tier: "high_for_output_surface_only"
      current_status: "accepted_as_downstream_shell"
      promotion_requirement: "preserve its derivative relation to Technical UST"
      blocking_reason: "none for downstream shell; blocked only if treated as peer truth object"
      downstream_risk_if_promoted_early: "Creative UST could collapse deep worksheet into Suno-facing prompt format"
      recommended_next_action: "use only after Technical UST and SEM admissibility state are bound"

- claim_or_artifact: "SEM is concurrent admissibility substrate"
      scope_plane: "PROJECT_MAESTRO"
      source_class: "SC2 + SC3"
      authority_tier: "high_as_quality_runtime_claim"
      current_status: "operative_but_relationships_unresolved"
      promotion_requirement: "resolve relation among SEM, SE20, BICDM-20, Q1-Q16, and G-Card"
      blocking_reason: "metric stack and scalar relationships unresolved"
      downstream_risk_if_promoted_early: "validators may double-count, mis-route, or flatten quality gates"
      recommended_next_action: "open SE20/BICDM/SEM reconciliation docket"

- claim_or_artifact: "Mosaic Engine v0.1"
      scope_plane: "BRIDGE_PROJECT_WORKSPACE"
      source_class: "SC4"
      authority_tier: "candidate"
      current_status: "formal_candidate_not_promoted"
      promotion_requirement: "operator adjudication plus replay-backed substrate boundary confirmation"
      blocking_reason: "candidate runtime spec emerged in files5 and was verified by files6 as candidate, not canon"
      downstream_risk_if_promoted_early: "Mosaic substrate may be frozen before boundary decisions close"
      recommended_next_action: "keep candidate labels in all Day 2 synthesis"

- claim_or_artifact: "Maestro v0"
      scope_plane: "BRIDGE_PROJECT_WORKSPACE"
      source_class: "SC4"
      authority_tier: "candidate"
      current_status: "formal_candidate_not_promoted"
      promotion_requirement: "operator adjudication plus distinction from Maestro.Project and Maestro.App"
      blocking_reason: "candidate product frame not final canon"
      downstream_risk_if_promoted_early: "Maestro app/product/runtime/project distinctions collapse"
      recommended_next_action: "namespace as Maestro.App candidate unless operator promotes"

- claim_or_artifact: "files4→files5→files6 chain"
      scope_plane: "WORKSPACE_DEV"
      source_class: "SC3"
      authority_tier: "controlling_for_wiring_recovery"
      current_status: "stable_V_and_V_chain"
      promotion_requirement: "not applicable as runtime canon; use as authority map basis"
      blocking_reason: "V&V chain controls evidence status, not final product definition"
      downstream_risk_if_promoted_early: "verification artifacts become architecture instead of governing architecture"
      recommended_next_action: "use as backbone of Authority Map v0.1"

operator_decision_docket:
  batch_1_persona_schema:
    objective: "Unblock Persona Schema without inventing missing council content."
    required_decisions:
      - decision_id: "OD-PER-001"
        issue: "SongCouncil metrics resolution path"
        options:
          - "recover exact legacy metrics before drafting"

- "operator author forward candidate metrics"
          - "carry NEEDS_SOURCE placeholders and limit schema to structural contract only"
        forensic_recommendation: "carry NEEDS_SOURCE unless exact source is recovered; do not forward-author metrics inside forensic workspace"
      - decision_id: "OD-PER-002"
        issue: "Executive committee composition"
        options:

- "recover exact historical composition"
          - "operator select current v5-c composition"
          - "define composition as unresolved interface"
        forensic_recommendation: "operator selection required before implementation schema"
    blocked_artifacts:
      - "Persona Schema"

- "Layer 5e executive red-pen review runtime"
      - "Q1-Q16 operational gate"
  batch_2_substrate_spec:
    objective: "Unblock Substrate Spec boundary without collapsing Mosaic into Maestro."
    required_decisions:
      - decision_id: "OD-SUB-001"
        issue: "Mosaic substrate boundary"
        forensic_recommendation: "treat Mosaic Engine v0.1 as candidate until explicit promotion"

- decision_id: "OD-SUB-002"
        issue: "memory layer versus deterministic engine boundary"
        forensic_recommendation: "separate state-binding, preference-memory, retrieval, and execution determinism"
      - decision_id: "OD-SUB-003"
        issue: "third surface naming"
        forensic_recommendation: "do not name forward from inference; require operator selection"

- decision_id: "OD-SUB-004"
        issue: "VIS/K8 and +4 surface governors"
        forensic_recommendation: "preserve as unresolved rather than infer from diagrams"
    blocked_artifacts:
      - "Substrate Spec"
      - "runtime boundary diagram"
      - "classifier-routing implementation"
      - "worker contract write-permission matrix"

day_2_execution_queue_from_this_workspace:
  - priority: 1
    slice: "evidence-contract"
    deliverable: "Authority Map v0.1"
    reason: >
      Prevents all other Day 2 slices from importing unstable authority
      assumptions. This is the safest continuation target because this workspace
      has stronger evidence-governance state than implementation-state.
    exit_criteria:

- "all major artifacts assigned source class"
      - "candidate/runtime/proposal/canon statuses separated"
      - "files1-3/files4/files5/files6 branch model represented"
      - "out-of-chain reference layers labeled"
      - "blocked claims linked to decision IDs"
  - priority: 2
    slice: "evidence-contract"
    deliverable: "Decision Docket v0.1"
    reason: "Converts broad unresolved contradictions into operator-actionable choices."
    exit_criteria:

- "Persona Schema blockers reduced to OD-PER decisions"
      - "Substrate Spec blockers reduced to OD-SUB decisions"
      - "SE20/BICDM/SEM/G-Card conflicts isolated"
  - priority: 3
    slice: "classifier-routing"
    deliverable: "Scope Classifier Stub Review"
    reason: "Classifier routing should not be authored until authority classes and scope planes are stable enough to avoid encoding drift."
    exit_criteria:

- "PROJECT_MAESTRO / WORKSPACE_DEV / BRIDGE_PROJECT_WORKSPACE / UNRESOLVED_SCOPE labels tested"
      - "artifact-first and node-first regressions rejected"
      - "candidate runtime specs routed as candidate, not canon"
  - priority: 4
    slice: "validator-tactical"
    deliverable: "Triad-validator import review"
    reason: "The external Claude session reportedly shipped a working validator slice, but this workspace should only use it after evidence classification."
    exit_criteria:

- "test suite imported or summarized with source boundaries"
      - "profiles v4_2_3 / v4_5_2 / v0_spec mapped to authority tiers"
      - "Boy Icarus E2E result classified as run evidence, not canon proof"

classifier_routing_seed:
  classification_rules:
    - rule_id: "CR-001"
      condition: "artifact defines or changes Maestro runtime behavior"
      default_scope: "PROJECT_MAESTRO"
      override: "if artifact is candidate/proposal only, route to BRIDGE_PROJECT_WORKSPACE until promoted"

- rule_id: "CR-002"
      condition: "artifact governs reconstruction, source gaps, authority tiers, or mutation replay"
      default_scope: "WORKSPACE_DEV"
      override: "if it stabilizes a project claim through replay-backed promotion, mirror into PROJECT_MAESTRO with provenance"
    - rule_id: "CR-003"
      condition: "artifact maps project concept to workspace process or candidate implementation"
      default_scope: "BRIDGE_PROJECT_WORKSPACE"
      override: "if unresolved boundary affects canon, also list under UNRESOLVED_SCOPE"

- rule_id: "CR-004"
      condition: "claim depends on missing source, operator decision, or unresolved metric relationship"
      default_scope: "UNRESOLVED_SCOPE"
      override: "none; unresolved must remain visible"
    - rule_id: "CR-005"
      condition: "claim appears only in assistant summary or Claude synthesis"
      default_scope: "BRIDGE_PROJECT_WORKSPACE"
      override: "promote only after replay evidence or operator acceptance"

- rule_id: "CR-006"
      condition: "claim appears in diagram/image only"
      default_scope: "BRIDGE_PROJECT_WORKSPACE"
      override: "never promote from visual evidence alone"
  stop_conditions:
    - "classifier promotes candidate runtime spec to canon without operator decision"
    - "classifier routes Creative UST as equal authority to Technical UST"

- "classifier collapses Maestro.Project, Maestro.App, Maestro.Runtime, Mosaic substrate, and workspace recovery"
    - "classifier resolves UNRESOLVED_SCOPE by choosing the most coherent option"
    - "classifier drops source-class metadata during export"

validator_tactical_notes:
  local_position: >
    Validator-tactical work is valuable but secondary from this workspace's
    perspective. A passing test suite can prove an implementation slice behaves
    under its assumptions, but it cannot decide whether the assumptions were
    canonically lawful.
  import_requirements:
